scope: Diagnostic color comparison of the autonomous RAW engine against existing Apple, AHD, bilinear and legacy engines. No measured camera calibration.

method.working: linear Rec.2020 D65 f32; XYZ D50/Lab for differences before SDR display
method.regions: 9 x 320-square at axis fractions .2/.5/.8, 32px margin, 256 x 16-square blocks per region
method.registration: Integer translation ±24 px, gradient cosine >=.85, distant peak gap >=.002, no search-boundary peak. Weak regions retained but excluded.
method.exposure: One scalar per engine/file, median anchor/candidate Y ratio from eligible blocks, at least 12 blocks and 3 zones. No channel gains or fitted profile.
method.domain: Both block sample ranges strictly (0,.98), positive XYZ with Y .01-.9, working-Y relative standard deviation <=.15. Recheck after gain. Not a sensor saturation mask.
method.aggregation: Median per file, then distribution across files. Original and repacked sources separate; blocks and repeated scene views are not independent captures. Pairwise masks can differ between engines, so this is not a ranking.

integer_white_vs_export_white_hypothesis.limits: D750 legacy decoder metadata confirms white 16383. D800 integer maximum inferred from native 12-bit RAW IFD. Neither is a measured physical saturation threshold.

container_controls.inference: Same autonomous pixels with different native-engine results implicate native profile/WB/level/baseline handling as well as reconstruction. White-level scale hypotheses agree with the measured AHD native-minus-DNG exposure offsets for the two controls; not physical saturation measurements or a reason to replace coefficients.

xt5_original_limit.interpretation: Coarse alignment agrees; high-frequency response/noise differs. No specific Apple internal stage or root cause established. The exploratory result does not override the frozen exclusion. DNG control has a separate accepted comparison.

repeatability.initial_run_interrupted_reason: Per-engine broker recreation incurred service-restart throttling; partial artifacts retained. Reused production brokers with unchanged recipe and measurement thresholds in a new campaign.

verification.native_smoke_limit: No screenshot events arrived before the 55-second limit; downstream screenshot verification found no PNGs. No decode/presentation error reported. Root cause unresolved, earlier GUI success is not attributed to the final host. Verification script now checks the smoke result before reading screenshot files.

gallery.browser_limit: Browser tool denied file:// navigation; no alternate browser route attempted. Offline script syntax and local image links checked.
gallery.review: Native and normalized D750 overview, corpus contact sheet, native/repacked X-T5 overview and center crops inspected. Interactive browser access to file:// was denied; offline JavaScript syntax and image links verified.
